mechanism_claims.claim_text: STAMP fusions C8H-C14H show stronger planktonic MIC activity against Streptococcus mutans than hLF1-11, while C8-C14 targeting fragments alone remain inactive at the tested upper concentration.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: C8H, C11H, C12H, C13H, C14H and comparator fragments
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is phenotypic MIC evidence, not a direct molecular mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Text and figure captions support selective biofilm growth inhibition for C8H-C14H against S. mutans with no obvious effect on S. gordonii or S. sanguis biofilms under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: STAMP fusions in single- and multi-species biofilm assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact graph-point values were not tabulated locally; final curation keeps qualitative/statistical figure-supported conclusions only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: C11H treatment is associated with downregulated S. mutans proteins including nucleic-acid-metabolism proteins in MALDI-TOF-MS/proteomic analysis, supporting an indirect mechanism hypothesis around DNA/nucleotide metabolism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper does not directly test DNA binding or enzyme inhibition by C11H in this study; the mechanism claim is proteomic/interpretive and must remain bounded.
